anchored_definition_en: done directly on the existing object, memory, or arrangement rather than creating a separate replacement; by extension, already established or set up.
blind_definitions: either directly modifying an existing object or memory rather than replacing it, or already present and established in the required arrangement
either modifying an existing object or memory directly rather than replacing it, or already established, arranged, or ready
Either by modifying the same stored object rather than replacing it, or already present, installed, or ready.

anchored_definition_en: A class of neural networks that use convolution operations, especially for processing spatial data such as images.
blind_definitions: neural networks that use convolutional layers to process spatial information, especially in computer vision
a class of neural networks built with convolutional layers and used especially to process spatial information such as images
Neural networks using convolutional layers to process spatial information efficiently, especially for computer vision.

anchored_definition_en: a small amount; used informally to mean slightly or somewhat.
blind_definitions: a small amount or degree, often used in the phrase 'a bit' to mean slightly or somewhat
a small amount or degree, as used in the expression a bit
A small amount or degree; in the phrase "a bit," slightly or somewhat.

anchored_definition_en: the LSTM gate that controls how much new input information enters the memory cell
blind_definitions: the LSTM gate that controls how much new input data contributes to the memory cell
the LSTM gate that controls how much new candidate information contributes to the memory cell
An LSTM gate that controls how much new candidate information is incorporated into the memory cell.

anchored_definition_en: layers in which each output unit is connected to all input units from the previous layer
blind_definitions: neural network layers, typically implemented as linear layers, in which each output unit connects to all inputs from the preceding layer
neural-network layers in which every output unit is connected to all inputs from the preceding layer, commonly implemented as Linear layers
Linear neural-network layers that can be stacked to form a multilayer perceptron.

anchored_definition_en: separate streams or dimensions of data, especially feature or color dimensions in neural networks and images
blind_definitions: separate data or feature dimensions in images and neural networks, such as RGB channels and convolutional input or output channels
components along the channel axis of image or feature tensors, representing color components or convolutional feature maps
Component planes along the channel dimension of image or convolutional-layer data, including RGB components and layer input or output channels.

anchored_definition_en: A convolution-based sequential recommendation model that captures recent activity patterns and user preferences.
blind_definitions: a convolutional sequence-embedding recommendation model that combines recent user activity patterns with general user tastes
a convolutional sequence-embedding recommendation model that uses a user's general preferences and recent activity to recommend items
A convolutional sequence-embedding recommendation model that uses horizontal and vertical convolutional networks to model recent user-activity patterns.

anchored_definition_en: the layer or class name for batch normalization.
blind_definitions: a neural-network normalization layer that uses batch statistics during training and maintains learned scale and shift parameters
a neural-network normalization layer that uses batch mean and variance during training and has learned scale and shift parameters
A neural-network layer or class that performs batch normalization using batch statistics and trainable scale and shift parameters.

anchored_definition_en: the named NVIDIA GPU computing software platform/version referenced for installing and running GPU-enabled deep learning code.
blind_definitions: NVIDIA's named GPU computing platform and software environment used to enable GPU-accelerated code
the named NVIDIA software platform installed in versioned releases to enable GPU-based computation
A versioned NVIDIA GPU-computing software platform or toolkit installed to enable GPU use.

anchored_definition_en: An optimization algorithm used to train models.
blind_definitions: the named optimization algorithm used as an optimizer to train machine learning models
a named optimization algorithm used to train models by updating their parameters
An optimization algorithm, or optimizer, used to train a model.

anchored_definition_en: surrounding linguistic or situational settings in which something appears or is used
blind_definitions: the surrounding linguistic or situational settings in which something appears, is interpreted, or is used
the surrounding circumstances, settings, or linguistic material in which something occurs or is interpreted
Either the linguistic surroundings of a word or token, or the broader setting or circumstances in which a method or result applies.

anchored_definition_en: the computation that carries inputs through a model to produce outputs; in code, the corresponding forward method
blind_definitions: the computation that carries an input through a model or its layers to produce an output or prediction
the forward computation that transforms model inputs into outputs or predictions, often implemented by a forward function or method
The model computation that applies its layers or functions to transform an input into an output or prediction.

anchored_definition_en: the model in a GAN that produces fake data samples to resemble real data
blind_definitions: the network in a generative adversarial network that produces fake samples intended to resemble real data and fool the discriminator
the network in a GAN that produces fake data resembling real data in order to fool the discriminator
The GAN network that produces fake data resembling real data and attempts to fool the discriminator.
